title: mosh: Add new dissector
description:
Add a dissector for mosh's State Synchronization Protocol.

Since I don't have edit access to the wiki at this point, I'm attaching a sample capture here for now: [mosh_key_aXK93PBQ0nvOJGFfqq1+LQ.pcap](/uploads/30314920954e0e8dd0ad6af8b75a27bd/mosh_key_aXK93PBQ0nvOJGFfqq1+LQ.pcap)

You can load it into wireshark and set the `MOSH_KEY` protocol option to `aXK93PBQ0nvOJGFfqq1+LQ`.

Screenshot (of the attached pcap file opened in Wireshark): ![mosh_wireshark](/uploads/128dc941d18102bbdc47eb10a4d9630b/mosh_wireshark.png)

changed this line in [version 2 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/970/diffs?diff_id=125998641&start_sha=76dbdeb58acb733b9679562f6f9390d764e40162#dad5c9732268b859eba3aef4cb013dd6f4bbf708_317_0)
changed it to avoid `goto`
can look packet-mosh.c:272:48: warning: Array access (via field 'clock_offset') results in a null pointer dereference

That can't happen. That branch is gated by `if (!pinfo->fd->visited)`, and earlier we set `mosh_info = (mosh_conv_info_t *)conversation_get_proto_data(conversation, proto_mosh);` under the same condition.

telnet uses the telnet protocol (hence packet-telnet.c), but so is PuTTY for instance. OpenSSH uses the SSH protocol (hence packet-ssh.c), but so is PuTTY for instance. Likewise mosh is using the SSP protocol, hence this dissector should be called and using 'ssp' instead of 'mosh'. We're not dissecting the application, we're dissecting the protocol.
Alright, I've renamed it to `ssyncp`. (`ssp` doesn't work, the "Scripting Service Protocol" already uses that name.) I hope that's fine?
